sn16.3:1.3: apakasseva kāyam apakassa cittaṃ niccanavakā kulesu appagabbhā || 3
sn16.3:1.4: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso jarūdapānaṃ vā olokeyya pabbatavisamaṃ vā nadīviduggaṃ vā
sn16.3:1.6: Evam eva kho bhikkhave candupamā kulāni upasaṅkamatha
sn16.3:1.7: apakasseva kāyam apakassa cittaṃ niccanavakā kulesu appagabbhā || ||
sn16.3:2.2: apakasseva kāyam apakassa cittaṃ niccanavako kulesu appagabbho || || 4
sn16.3:2.5: Bhagavaṃmūlakā no bhante dhammā bhagavannettikā bhagavaṃpaṭisaraṇā || || Sādhu vata bhante Bhagavantaṃ yeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho || Bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti || || 6
sn16.3:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā ākāse pāṇiṃ cālesi || ||
sn16.3:3.2: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave ayaṃ ākāse pāṇi na sajjati na gayhati na bajjhati ||
sn16.3:3.3: Evam eva kho bhikkhave yassa kassaci bhikkhuno kulāni upasaṅkamato kulesu cittaṃ na sajjati na gayhati na bajjhati ||
sn16.3:3.5: Yathā sakena lābhena attamano hoti sumano || evam paresaṃ lābhena attamano hoti sumano || ||
sn16.3:3.6: Evarūpo kho bhikkhave bhikkhu arahati kulāni upasaṅkamituṃ || ||
sn16.3:4.1: Kassapassa bhikkhave kulāni upasaṅkamato kulesu cittaṃ na sajjati na gayhati na bajjhati ||
sn16.3:4.3: Yathā sakena lābhena attamano hoti sumano ||
sn16.3:4.4: Evaṃ paresaṃ lābhena attamano hoti sumano || || [
sn16.3:5.1: Evarūpo kho bhikkhave bhikkhu arahati kulāni upasaṅkamituṃ] || || 10 Taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhikkhave || ||
sn16.3:5.2: Kathaṃrūpassa bhikkhuno aparisuddhā dhammadesanā hoti || || Kathaṃrūpassa bhikkhuno parisuddhā dhammadesanā hotīti || || 11
sn16.3:5.3: Bhagavaṃmūlakā no bhante dhammā bhagavannettikā bhagavaṃpaṭisaraṇā || Sādhu vata bhante Bhagavantaṃ yeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho || Bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dharessantīti || || 12
sn16.3:5.4: Tena hi bhikkhave suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasi karotha bhāsissāmīti || ||
sn16.3:5.5: Evam bhante ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ || ||
sn16.3:6.1: Yo hi koci bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃcitto paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti ||
sn16.3:6.2: Aho vata me dhammaṃ suṇeyyuṃ || sutvā ca dhammaṃ pasīdeyyuṃ || pasannā ca me pasannā kāram kareyyunti || ||
sn16.3:6.3: Evarūpassa kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno aparisuddhā dhammadesanā hoti || 14
sn16.3:7.1: Yo ca kho bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ citto paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti ||
sn16.3:7.2: Svākhyāto Bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattam veditabbo viññūhīti ||
sn16.3:7.3: aho vata me dhammaṃ suṇeyyaṃ || sutvāca dhammam ājāneyyuṃ || ājānitvā ca pana tathattāya paṭipajjeyyunti || ||
sn16.3:7.4: Iti dhammasudhammataṃ paṭicca paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti || || Kāruññaṃ paṭicca anudayam paticca anukampam upādāya paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti || ||
sn16.3:7.5: Evarūpassa kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno parisuddhā dhammadesanā hoti || || 15
sn16.3:8.1: Kassapo bhikkhave evaṃcitto paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti || ||
sn16.3:8.2: Svākhyāto Bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattam veditabbo viññūhīti || ||
sn16.3:8.3: Aho vata me dhammaṃ suṇeyyuṃ || sutvā ca pana dhammam ājāneyyuṃ || ājānitvā ca pana tatthattāya paṭipajjeyyunti || ||
sn16.3:8.4: Iti dhammasudhammatam paṭicca anudayam paṭicca anukampam upādāya paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti || || 16
sn16.3:8.5: Kassapena vā hi vo bhikkhave ovadissāmi yo vā panassa kassapasadiso || ovāditehi ca pana vo tathattāya paṭipajjitabbanti || ||
